description: This file defines a React component for a session management dashboard page, allowing users to view and delete session records. It includes UI elements such as a data table, modal dialogs for confirmation, and API calls to fetch and delete sessions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches session data from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Sets the session record to be deleted, triggering the confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDeleteAction
methods.description: Deletes the selected session after user confirmation and reloads the session list.
